_comment: Pelican / Pterodactyl egg for FluentMC. Import in the panel under Eggs -> Import.
name: FluentMC (Fabric 26.3)
author: scott_howson@corruptiongames.net
description: FluentMC modpack server: Fabric for Minecraft 26.3 with server-side mods installed from the pack's .mrpack index.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# FluentMC: installs the Fabric server launcher and every server-side file listed in the .mrpack, hash-verified.
set -eo pipefail
apt-get update -qq >/dev/null 2>&1 && apt-get install -y -qq curl jq unzip >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
mkdir -p /mnt/server && cd /mnt/server
echo "Downloading pack: ${MRPACK_URL}"
curl -fsSL -o pack.mrpack "${MRPACK_URL}"
rm -rf pack && mkdir pack && unzip -oq pack.mrpack -d pack
IDX=pack/modrinth.index.json
MC=$(jq -r '.dependencies.minecraft' "$IDX")
LOADER=$(jq -r '.dependencies["fabric-loader"]' "$IDX")
INSTALLER=$(curl -fsSL https://meta.fabricmc.net/v2/versions/installer | jq -r '[.[]|select(.stable)][0].version')
echo "Fabric server: Minecraft $MC, loader $LOADER, installer $INSTALLER"
curl -fsSL -o "${SERVER_JARFILE}" "https://meta.fabricmc.net/v2/versions/loader/${MC}/${LOADER}/${INSTALLER}/server/jar"
rm -rf mods && mkdir -p mods
jq -r '.files[] | select(.env.server != "unsupported") | "\(.path)\t\(.hashes.sha512)\t\(.downloads[0])"' "$IDX" |
while IFS=$'\t' read -r path sha url; do
  mkdir -p "$(dirname "$path")"
  curl -fsSL -o "$path" "$url"
  echo "$sha  $path" | sha512sum -c --quiet -
  echo "  + $path"
done
[ -d pack/overrides ] && cp -r pack/overrides/. .
[ -d pack/server-overrides ] && cp -r pack/server-overrides/. .
rm -rf pack pack.mrpack
echo "FluentMC install complete."
